title: How much does Trump care about the GOP?
description: The president’s own public comments and actions have called his commitment into question.

title: How Canada, with elbows up, could hurt Trump in the midterms
description: The president's fight with our neighbor to the north — a constant over the course of his second term with a focus on trade — has turned ugly in recent weeks.

title: Trump is remodeling the White House. The group set up to protect it has stayed quiet.
description: The White House Historical Association, a nonprofit set up by Jacqueline Kennedy to preserve the building’s character, has declined to criticize the president’s changes.

title: Establishment wins and other takeaways from the New Hampshire primaries
description: Former Republican senator John E. Sununu and Democratic Rep. Chris Pappas easily won their primaries for an open U.S. Senate seat.

title: Republicans gather for two-day ‘Trumpalooza’ with midterms approaching
description: At Trump's urging, the GOP is staging a midterm convention centered on him.

title: Iran sends wave of missiles toward U.S. base in Jordan after vowing escalation
description: Under economic pressure from the U.S., Iranian leaders have signaled they will not capitulate amid stunted diplomatic efforts to end the war.

title: National Guard member arrested in DC, accused of drawing gun on fellow Guard member
description: A member of the Georgia National Guard deployed in Washington, D.C., as part of a task force to fight crime, has been arrested for pulling a gun on a fellow Guard member in an alleged dispute over regulation haircuts.

title: Mail-in voters weigh flying to vote in person and other backup plans amid uncertainty
description: Voters and election officials are navigating uncertainty about mail-in voting for the midterms as the legal fight drags on over the U.S. Postal Service plan for President Trump's bid for restrictions.

title: Republicans kick off a 'Trumpapalooza' of a midterm convention Wednesday in Texas
description: Republicans have never held a midterm convention before. But there's also never been a president like Donald Trump. Billed as a "Trumpapalooza," the unprecedented event kicks of in Dallas Wednesday.

title: Judges may face unprecedented decisions this election. A new guide seeks to help
description: The idea of law enforcement taking possession of ballots in the middle of an active election used to be considered impossible. Now, it's a scenario voting officials — and judges — are training for.

title: Trump gave $45,000 cash gifts to Natalie Harp, two other close aides
description: Financial disclosures show the sums were equivalent to nearly one-third of each of their salaries. Experts say the gifts are without precedent and may violate the law.

title: Honoring 9/11 heroes, Trump repeats disputed account of his role in recovery
description: Trump awarded the Medal of Freedom posthumously to Welles Crowther, who saved an estimated 18 people before dying in the World Trade Center.

title: Conflicting court rulings leave Missouri congressional map in chaos
description: Supreme Court Justice Brett M. Kavanaugh and a federal judge issued opposite decisions on the fate of a congressional map that favored the GOP, leaving races in limbo.

title: Armed man charged after confronting Ohio governor candidate at county fair
description: The suspect pleaded not guilty to assault and inducing panic after pushing through a crowd toward Amy Acton. He was accused of knocking down two elderly people.

title: Authorities decline to prosecute woman who made false report against Buttigieg
description: The accuser has a history of alcohol abuse, hallucinations and delusional thinking, according to an Indiana prosecutor who determined she was not able to form criminal intent.

title: Sen. Roger Marshall’s challenger in Kansas criticizes him for suing patients
description: Adam Hamilton, a Methodist pastor, is facing an uphill battle against Marshall. No Democrat has won a Senate race in the state since 1932.

title: Paxton’s former top law enforcement official endorses Talarico
description: David Maxwell, a former Texas Ranger decorated for his decades of service, reported Paxton to the FBI in 2020.

title: DHS asks Supreme Court to let it use Social Security data to verify voter rolls
description: The case, seeking to help officials ensure potential voters are citizens, is among the election-related disputes the court is considering ahead of the midterms.

title: Supreme Court declines Catholic mother’s bid for son’s vaccine exemption in N.Y.
description: The Supreme Court on Tuesday rejected a New York woman's bid to send her son to kindergarten without state-mandated vaccines, a requirement that she claimed infringed on her religious rights.

title: Iceland summons U.S. envoy over Trump map depicting it in stars and stripes
description: A Trump post showed the country, along with Canada, Cuba, Mexico and Greenland, covered in red, white and blue, and labeled “United States of America.”

title: Why Ohio is such a competitive state this year
description: It’s got a major governor’s race, marquee Senate contest and House elections, all of which Democrats have a chance to win.

title: NYC voters give Mamdani high marks, say mayor is doing better than expected
description: A new Suffolk University poll also finds New York voters disagree with GOP calls for Mayor Zohran Mamdani to stay away from 9/11 memorial.

title: Lindsay Clancy’s attorney makes public plea for Trump pardon
description: Kevin Reddington also said he hoped to arrange an agreement with prosecutors that would be “acceptable to both sides.”

title: The last test of dynastic politics in an anti-establishment primary season
description: The two distinct races represent the last gasp of dynastic politics in a primary season largely defined by deep antiestablishment fervor.

title: This House candidate wants you to know she helped imprison a fellow Democrat
description: Shannon Taylor touts her prosecutor past as she runs against Rep. Rob Wittman (R) for a battleground seat in Virginia.

title: After Charlie Kirk’s death, Turning Point forges ahead, with eyes on JD Vance
description: The conservative group’s leaders still grapple with grief. But they also have a mission: 2028.

title: Rare charges against ICE agent highlight DOJ’s broader retreat from shooting probes
description: The case against Christian Castro is unprecedented in President Donald Trump’s second term, as ICE agents face little fallout from shootings of protesters and others.

title: Veterans and Democrats intensify fight against Trump’s planned arch
description: Opponents of the 250-foot triumphal arch project say it could disrupt military burials at Arlington, during construction and after its completion.

title: The 2026 midterm general election season is upon us. Here's what to watch
description: The week of Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season. President Trump's unpopularity and Democratic enthusiasm means control of Congress is on the ballot.

title: Republicans hope unconventional convention will rally voters ahead of midterms
description: The Republican party is calling it a "Trumpapalooza." The party is throwing an unconventional convention in Dallas this week to try to boost Republican voter enthusiasm.

title: Political commentator on what we might expect from Trump's midterm convention
description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with commentator Jonah Goldberg about this week's unusual Republican midterm gathering.

title: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
description: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

title: Administration strips language that criticized Confederate statue at Arlington
description: A new sign at Arlington National Cemetery omits wording that said the 32-foot bronze statue “mythologized” the Confederacy and gave “sanitized” depictions of slavery.

title: With Ohio’s governorship up for grabs, a toxic race turns violent
description: An alleged assailant forced his way Sunday toward Democratic candidate Amy Acton at a county fair, officials and witnesses said.  Authorities said he was carrying two pistols and a Taser.

title: Emergency crew rescues worker injured during White House construction
description: Local dispatchers called for a “high-angle rescue” for the worker, who was part of a team removing scaffolding from Trump’s project on the North Portico.

title: Trump suggests renaming New Mexico amid torrent of online memes and taunts
description: The suggestion came as the president unleashed dozens of social media posts. He lacks authority to rename New Mexico or any other state.

title: Trump's construction projects are transforming the capital
description: President Trump is transforming Washington. New York Magazine's Ben Terris says the ballroom, the planned arch and other changes are an attempt to achieve "architectural immortality."

title: Armed individual lunged at Democratic nominee for Ohio governor
description: Multiple people were injured at the event for Amy Acton at a county fair in Canfield, Ohio.

title: With the midterms fast approaching, campaign season begins
description: Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season as Republicans work to maintain control of the House and the Senate amid President Trump's unpopular second term.
